title: Not Enough Things
description: This modpack adds new biomes, structures, ores, and more
body:
Explore a completely new Minecraft experience with this amazing modpack! 🌍✨
The world is now bigger and more exciting than ever before. Discover dozens of new biomes filled with unique landscapes, colorful forests, massive mountains, dangerous caves, and beautiful rivers. Every adventure feels fresh and different!

🏰 The modpack also adds many new structures to explore, including castles, hidden dungeons, ancient ruins, villages, and mysterious underground locations full of loot and secrets.

⛏️ Find and mine brand-new ores that can be used to craft powerful tools, armor, and special items. Mining is now much more rewarding and fun.

🎥 Mobs now have improved animations, making the game feel more alive and realistic. Animals, monsters, and villagers move smoother and look better during combat and exploration.

🌅 Beautiful shaders are included to completely transform the graphics with realistic lighting, shadows, water reflections, waving leaves, and stunning sunsets. Minecraft has never looked this immersive!
